# Working

I calculated each order's value as `quantity × unit_price × (1 − discount%)`, then filtered by status/date/region/product/customer as needed.

**Q1 – March 2026 Net Revenue**
Summed all "Completed" orders dated in March 2026 (SO-2048 to SO-2075, excluding refunded/cancelled SO-2054, SO-2059):
**Total = £22,869.15**

**Q2 – Highest Net Revenue Region in Q2 (Apr–Jun)**
Region totals (Completed only):
- East: £5,564.00
- West: £14,194.65
- South: £4,760.20
- North: £7,861.75

**West** wins by a wide margin.

**Q3 – Product with Highest % Growth (Q1→Q2)**
Product net revenue (Completed only):

| Product | Q1 | Q2 | Growth |
|---|---|---|---|
| Standing Desk | 5,880.00 | 7,077.00 | +20.4% |
| Filing Cabinet | 17,172.00 | 13,104.00 | -23.7% |
| Desk Chair | 14,811.75 | 4,690.75 | -68.3% |
| Desk Lamp | 2,112.80 | 644.10 | -69.5% |
| Whiteboard | 9,096.25 | 4,004.75 | -56.0% |
| Monitor Arm | 1,436.50 | 2,860.00 | **+99.1%** |

**Monitor Arm** grew the most, by **+99.1%**.

**Q4 – Value Lost to Refunded/Cancelled Orders (Jan–Jun)**
Summed order values for all Refunded and Cancelled orders (14 orders):
**Total = £11,773.75**

**Q5 – Highest Net Revenue Customer (Jan–Jun)**
Summed Completed order values per customer. Top result:
**Juniper Health Clinic = £9,913.00**
(Next highest: Dunmore Logistics £8,312.70, Copperfield Law £7,537.00)

**Q6 – Average Net Order Value in Q1**
- Q1 Net Revenue (Jan+Feb+Mar Completed) = £11,034.95 + £16,605.20 + £22,869.15 = **£50,509.30**
- Q1 Completed order count = 19 (Jan) + 21 (Feb) + 26 (Mar) = **66**
- Average = 50,509.30 / 66 = **£765.29**
